Courier New Italic.ttf (b5c6d453..., GDEF/GSUB/GPOS 162/914/8502) and Courier New Bold Italic.ttf (60e4c514..., 114/928/8322) are not blocklisted and their .notdef is GDEF class 1, so Java keeps the unmapped mark; the tip zeroes it. CONFIRMED port defect (Java differential, held out). java_bidi::text_line_levels returns Paragraph.levels, which for direction LTR/RTL are per-paragraph para_level_at(i); TextLine uses BidiUtils.getLevels, i.e. BidiLine.getRuns, which for a non-MIXED direction is ONE run at the first paragraph's paraLevel (the maker's own account says so: 'for direction LTR/RTL all levels are paraLevel'). 352 of 120,295 DIRECTION_DEFAULT_LEFT_TO_RIGHT inputs differ, all multi-paragraph (U+2029, U+0085, U+001C..U+001E, CR, LF before the end). A label that keeps such a separator and is otherwise all RTL is split into components where Java has one; no PlantUML whole-output case shows it yet.
